thread_text:
sara_marketing: Fjordlane agreed to a customer spotlight + short benchmark. Interview set Thu 9am PT. Need legal release + metric confirmation by Wed EOD.
dave_pm: Proposed webinar tie: 30m customer story + 20m live demo. Well capture clips for social.
olga_legal: Send full legal entity and contact. If we publish absolute latency numbers, require written confirm from their engineering lead.
sara_marketing: Legal name: Fjordlane Inc., contact: Priya Rao (Head of ML). Priya ok with public blog and clips.
mike_prod: For benchmark, we ran their workload on Redwood Dedicated (3x A100). Median 512-token latency ~55ms. Can share anonymized logs.
nina_eng: Recommend phrasing: "median latency around 55ms for 512-token requests" to avoid implying exactness.
dave_pm: Draft quote: "Redwood helped us go from batch to real-time, cutting response times by about 2.7x." Thoughts?
olga_legal: Prefer "about 2.5x" until we finalize telemetry. Also need signed release before publishing quotes or embedding recording.
sara_marketing: I'll send release template and ping Priya. Uploading draft copy to drive: https://drive.redwood/fjordlane/draft.md
hubspot-bot: Reminder: add utm_campaign=fjordlane-spotlight and tag lead_source=customer_story in HubSpot mapping.
dave_pm: Routing: webinar signups with intent=trial -> sales-trials@, demo intents -> ae-eu@. Can someone set that mapping?
mike_prod: I'll set the mapping and create the content gate for company + use-case + #users.
sara_marketing: Priya replied at 16:10: she confirmed the latency numbers and attached a signed release. She also provided a 2-sentence bio.
olga_legal: Received signed release and metric confirmation. Legal clears publication. :white_check_mark:
dave_pm: Awesome. I'll finalize the run-of-show and send calendar invites. Target publish date set for 2025-04-08 after webinar.
sara_marketing: Thanks team  moving to production prep. Will post final copy for review tomorrow. :rocket:
